results.description:
He rejected his fated mate. Now the bond is back, and the whole pack may bleed for it.

Aria was supposed to be the future Luna of the Black Ridge pack.

Instead, the Alpha heir publicly rejected her, shattered their sacred bond, and left her branded with a suppression mark that caged her wolf. Cast out and forced to survive on the brutal fringes of shifter territory, she built a life from silence, scars, and the promise that she would never belong to Maddox again.

Then the hunters find her.

Maddox has spent years haunted by the rejection that destroyed them both. Now ruthless, powerful, and bound by a pack hierarchy rotting from within, he knows the truth is worse than betrayal. Aria was never weak. She was hidden. Her bloodline is rare, dangerous, and valuable enough to kill for.

When the bond between them flares back to life, it is violent, obsessive, and impossible to ignore. Maddox will burn through hunters, elders, and every law Black Ridge was built on to keep her alive. But Aria is no longer the broken girl he cast aside, and she refuses to trade one cage for another.

The pack wants obedience.

The hunters want blood.

Maddox wants a second chance he has not earned.

And Aria wants the truth, even if uncovering it tears the Black Ridge apart.

In a world of silver, secrets, and savage mate bonds, the most dangerous thing alive is a rejected mate with nothing left to lose.
